run_llava_instruct_mix: run the script to process LLaVA instruct mix dataset from theblackcat102 into conversational format
process_example_messages: process an example by converting conversations field into structured messages with roles and image references
filter_long_examples: filter out dataset examples where total message content length exceeds 1000 characters
split_prompt_completion: split messages into prompt and completion with the last message as the model response
push_dataset_to_hub: push the processed dataset and model card to a Hugging Face Hub repository
